title: Yara and the Monsoon
author: E. M. Quintana
blurb: Jonah Iversen, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must cross the range ahead of the snows before the concession permits expire.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
